Step 3: the panel “[[settings.roles.empty_title]]” lists the role.
Step 4: “[[settings.saved]]” and “[[settings.reassigned.one|who=(name of test.lim.accountant)]]”. The roles page shows the holder and the substitute as before.
Step 5: the holder has the card and an email labelled “[[mail.status.action]]”.

move_not_to_requester.title: A requester who becomes the holder never gets the task of their own request
move_not_to_requester.pre: One Nicosia request made by test.nic.requester, waiting at step 2 on test.nic.accountant. The roles of Nicosia are as loaded.
steps: On “[[settings.roles]]” choose test.nic.requester as holder of [[role.dir_accountant]] of Nicosia and keep test.nic.deputy as substitute. Press “[[settings.save]]”.
Open the request as test.nic.requester.
Open the request as test.nic.deputy.
As the administrator read the email log.
Put the roles back: test.nic.accountant as holder, test.nic.deputy as substitute. Press “[[settings.save]]”.
exp: Step 1: “[[settings.saved]]” and “[[settings.reassigned.one|who=(name of test.nic.deputy)]]”. The task goes to the substitute, not to the new holder.
Step 2: the requester has no card. Step 2 of the tracker says “[[tracker.acting_for|who=(substitute)|holder=(requester)]]” with “[[tracker.redirect.conflict_of_interest]]”.
Step 3: the substitute has the card.
Step 4: a mail to test.nic.deputy labelled “[[mail.status.action]]”, and a mail to the requester with “[[mail.task_redirected.intro.conflict_of_interest|who=(substitute)]]”.
Step 5: “[[settings.saved]]”. The task stays with test.nic.deputy, who is still the substitute.

move_substitute_changed.title: A new substitute gets the tasks the old one held
move_substitute_changed.pre: The roles of Nicosia are as loaded.
steps: As test.nic.accountant press “[[ooo.switch_on]]” in the panel “[[ooo.title]]” of the list.
As test.nic.requester submit a Nicosia request. Check that test.nic.deputy has its task.
As the administrator open the page of test.nic.accountant. In the row “[[role.dir_accountant]]” choose test.nic.hr in “[[settings.col.substitute]]” and press “[[settings.save]]”.
Open the request as test.nic.hr, then as test.nic.deputy.
As the administrator choose test.nic.deputy as substitute again and press “[[settings.save]]”. Then, as test.nic.accountant, press “[[ooo.switch_off]]”.
exp: Step 3: “[[settings.saved]]” and “[[settings.reassigned.one|who=(name of test.nic.hr)]]”.
Step 4: test.nic.hr has the card, “[[tracker.acting_for|who=(test.nic.hr)|holder=(test.nic.accountant)]]” with “[[tracker.redirect.out_of_office]]”. test.nic.deputy has none.
Step 5: the save moves the task back to test.nic.deputy, with the same kind of line. “[[ooo.switch_off]]” then moves nothing: the task stays with the substitute.

viewer_role.title: A viewer sees every request and can act on none
viewer_role.pre: The sample requests are loaded. Sample request 3 waits for the CEO.
steps: Sign in as test.demo.viewer. Look at the tab that opens and at the menu.
Look for the button “[[list.new]]”. Type /requests/new in the address bar.
Open sample request 3.
Type /settings and then /audit in the address bar.
Go back to the list and look for “[[list.export]]”.
exp: The list opens on the tab “[[list.tab.all]]” with the submitted requests of every Directorate and no drafts. The menu has “[[nav.requests]]” and “[[nav.manuals]]” only.
There is no “[[list.new]]” button. /requests/new shows “[[error.404]]”.
The request page shows the details, “[[page.checks]]” and “[[page.history]]”. There is no card “[[action.title]]” and no “[[action.withdraw]]” button.
Both addresses show “[[error.404]]”.
The viewer has the button “[[list.export]]”.

manuals_page.title: The Manuals page: user guide for all, administrator files for administrators
steps: As test.nic.requester press “[[nav.manuals]]” in the menu.
Press “[[manuals.user_guide]]”.
Type /manuals/admin_guide in the address bar.
As test.demo.admin press “[[nav.manuals]]”.
Press “[[manuals.uat_scripts]]”. Switch the language and press it again.
Sign out and type /manuals/user_guide in the address bar.
exp: Step 1: the page “[[manuals.title]]” has one item, “[[manuals.user_guide]]”, with the line “[[manuals.user_guide.about]]”.
Step 2: the guide opens as a PDF in a new tab, in the language of the page.
Step 3: “[[error.404]]”.
Step 4: four items: “[[manuals.user_guide]]”, “[[manuals.admin_guide]]”, “[[manuals.uat_plan]]” and “[[manuals.uat_scripts]]”.
Step 5: the browser downloads eHire-UAT-test-scripts-en.xlsx in English and eHire-UAT-test-scripts-el.xlsx in Greek.
Step 6: the sign-in page. No manual is served to someone who is not signed in.

pw_helpers.title: Password fields: show or hide, Caps Lock and keyboard language
pw_helpers.pre: A computer keyboard that can type Greek and English. Signed out.
steps: On the sign-in page click in the field “[[login.password]]” and type an English letter.
Switch the keyboard to Greek and type a letter.
Switch on Caps Lock and type a letter. Switch it off and type another.
Press the button with the eye at the end of the field. Press it again.
Sign in and press “[[nav.password]]” in the menu. Type in both fields.
exp: Step 1: under the field, “[[pw.kbd_en]]” and “[[pw.caps_off]]”.
Step 2: “[[pw.kbd_el]]”, highlighted.
Step 3: “[[pw.caps_on]]”, highlighted, then “[[pw.caps_off]]”.
Step 4: the characters show and the button is named “[[pw.hide]]”. The second press hides them and the name is “[[pw.show]]” again.
Step 5: both fields of “[[password.title]]” have the same button and the same lines.

num_shape.title: The request number: Directorate, position code, date and counter
steps: Submit a nursing request for Nicosia (test) with the position “Staff Nurse (test)”. Write down the number.
Submit a second request with the same position on the same day.
Submit a third request with the position “Midwife (test)”.
In “[[list.search]]” type today's date as it stands in the number (for example 20261126).
exp: The first number has the shape EHIRE-TNIC-NUR-20261126-01: EHIRE, the Directorate code without its dash (T-NIC), the position code, the day of submission in Cyprus time as year, month, day, and a two-digit counter.
The second number is the same up to the date and its counter is one higher.
The third number carries MID and its own counter, which starts at 01 for that Directorate, position and day.
The search finds the three requests.

num_draft_resubmit.title: A draft has no number; a resubmission keeps its number
num_draft_resubmit.pre: A returned request of this requester (sample request 6, or the one from the case “Return a request to the requester”).
steps: Press “[[list.new]]”, fill the facility and the category and press “[[action.save_draft]]”. Look at the row in the tab “[[list.tab.mine]]”.
Open the draft, fill the rest and press “[[form.submit]]”.
Open the returned request and write down its number. Press “[[form.title.resubmit]]”.
Change the text “[[field.need_text]]”, fill “[[form.resubmit_note]]” and press “[[action.resubmit]]”.
Read the number on the request page and in the list.
exp: Step 1: the row shows “[[status.draft]]” where the number would be. A draft has no number.
Step 2: the number is given at submission and carries the date of that day.
Step 5: “[[done.resubmit]]”. The number is exactly the one you wrote down, whatever today's date is. A request never gets a second number.

num_position_code.title: The position code in the positions list goes into the number
num_position_code.pre: The position “Secretary (test)” has the code SEC, as loaded. Put it back at the end.
steps: As the administrator open “[[nav.settings]]” and “[[settings.list.position]]”. Read the column “[[settings.col.position_code]]”.
In the row of “Secretary (test)” type ΓΡΑ (Greek letters) as the code and press “[[settings.save]]”.
Type tst and press “[[settings.save]]”.
As test.nic.requester submit an administrative request with that position. Read the number.
As the administrator empty the code and save. Submit one more request with the position. Then set the code back to SEC.
exp: Each test position has a code of two to six Latin letters or digits.
Step 2: the browser does not send the form and shows the hint “[[settings.position_code_hint]]” (sent anyway, the page says “[[settings.position_code_invalid]]”).
Step 3: “[[settings.saved]]”. The code is stored in capitals, TST.
Step 4: the number carries TST, for example EHIRE-TNIC-TST-20261126-01.
Step 5: with no code the number carries the code of the staff category: ADM for administrative (MED, NUR, ALH and OTH for the others). Numbers given earlier do not change.

cc_by_directorate.title: The form offers only the cost centres of the chosen Directorate
cc_by_directorate.pre: The test data is loaded: T-1001 to T-1003 belong to Nicosia (test), T-1004 to Limassol – Paphos (test), T-1009 and T-1010 to no Directorate.
steps: As test.nic.requester press “[[list.new]]” and open the list “[[field.cost_centre]]”.
As test.central.hr press “[[list.new]]”, choose Limassol – Paphos (test) as Directorate and open the list.
Change the Directorate to Nicosia (test) and choose T-1001.
Change the Directorate back to Limassol – Paphos (test) and look at the field.
exp: Step 1: T-1001, T-1002 and T-1003, then the cost centres with no Directorate (T-1009, T-1010 and any you added without one). No cost centre of another Directorate and none of eFinance's. Each line shows the code, then the name.
Step 2: T-1004 and the cost centres with no Directorate.
Step 3: the list changes as soon as the Directorate changes.
Step 4: T-1001 is no longer chosen or offered. You must choose again.

cc_search.title: Search the cost centres on the form
cc_search.pre: On the form “[[form.title.new]]”, with the Directorate Nicosia (test).
steps: In “[[form.cost_centre_search]]” type 1002.
Clear the box and type ward (on the Greek screen: κλινικη, without the accent).
Clear the box, type 1003 and choose T-1003 in the list. Then type zzz in the box.
Clear the box. Then press Enter inside it.
exp: The box shows the hint “[[form.cost_centre_search.placeholder]]”.
Step 1: “[[form.cost_centre_matches.one]]” and the list holds only T-1002.
Step 2: “[[form.cost_centre_matches.many|n=2]]”: T-1001 and T-1002. Capitals and accents make no difference.
Step 3: “[[form.cost_centre_matches.many|n=0]]”. The cost centre you chose stays in the list and stays chosen.
Step 4: the whole list is back and the count line is empty. Enter does not submit the form.

cc_inactive.title: A deactivated cost centre is not offered on the form
cc_inactive.pre: T-1003 is active. Use a test cost centre (code T-): the sync leaves those alone.
steps: As the administrator open “[[nav.settings]]” and “[[settings.list.cost_centre]]”. Read the line at the foot of the list.
Choose Nicosia (test) in “[[settings.filter.directorate]]” and press “[[settings.filter.apply]]”.
In the row T-1003 press “[[settings.deactivate]]”.
As test.nic.requester open “[[list.new]]” and the list “[[field.cost_centre]]”. Type 1003 in the search box.
As the administrator press “[[settings.activate]]” in the row T-1003.
exp: Step 1: the list shows 50 cost centres a page, with “[[settings.page|n=1|total=…]]” and the button “[[settings.next]]”.
Step 2: only T-1001, T-1002 and T-1003.
Step 3: “[[settings.saved]]”. The row shows “[[settings.inactive]]” and the page keeps the filter.
Step 4: T-1003 is not in the list, and the search gives “[[form.cost_centre_matches.many|n=0]]”.
Step 5: “[[settings.saved]]”, and the form offers T-1003 again.

cc_directorate_change.title: A cost centre follows the Directorate set in Settings
cc_directorate_change.pre: T-1010 belongs to no Directorate, as loaded. Put it back at the end.
steps: As the administrator open “[[settings.list.cost_centre]]”, choose “[[settings.filter.none]]” in “[[settings.filter.directorate]]” and press “[[settings.filter.apply]]”.
In the row T-1010 choose Limassol – Paphos (test) in “[[field.directorate]]” and press “[[settings.save]]”.
As test.nic.requester open “[[list.new]]” and the list “[[field.cost_centre]]”.
As test.lim.requester do the same.
As the administrator find T-1010 under the filter Limassol – Paphos (test), choose “[[settings.cost_centre.none]]” in “[[field.directorate]]” and press “[[settings.save]]”.
exp: Step 1: T-1009 and T-1010, and any cost centre added without a Directorate.
Step 2: “[[settings.saved]]”. T-1010 leaves the filtered list.
Step 3: Nicosia no longer offers T-1010.
Step 4: Limassol – Paphos offers it.
Step 5: “[[settings.saved]]”. Every Directorate offers T-1010 again.

efin_sync_now.title: The eFinance panel and “Sync now”
efin_sync_now.pre: The eFinance link is on. If the panel shows “[[settings.inactive]]” there is no button: write “Blocked” and tell the project owner.
steps: Open “[[nav.settings]]” and “[[settings.list.cost_centre]]”. Read the panel “[[settings.efinance.title]]”.
Press “[[settings.efinance.sync_now]]”.
Read the line “[[settings.efinance.last_run|date=…]]” in the panel.
Choose Nicosia (test) in “[[settings.filter.directorate]]” and press “[[settings.filter.apply]]”.
exp: The panel shows the label “[[settings.active]]”, the line “[[settings.efinance.state_http]]”, the line “[[settings.efinance.budget_label]]: [[settings.efinance.budget.exists]]”, the last sync and the note “[[settings.efinance.hand_edit]]”.

Step 2: a green message, “[[settings.efinance.result.unchanged]]”. If eFinance changed since the last sync it gives the counts instead: “[[settings.efinance.result.changed|added=…|updated=…|deactivated=…|reactivated=…]]”.
Step 3: the date and time of now, in Cyprus time, with the same result.
Step 4: the test cost centres (codes T-) are still “[[settings.active]]”. The sync never switches them off.

efin_sync_restores.title: The sync sets a hand change back to eFinance's values
efin_sync_restores.pre: The eFinance link is on. You change one of eFinance's cost centres for a minute; the sync puts it back, so nothing stays changed.
steps: On “[[settings.list.cost_centre]]” filter by a Directorate of eFinance (not a test one). Write down the code and the names of the first active cost centre.
Add the letter X to “[[settings.col.name_en]]” of that row and press “[[settings.save]]”.
Press “[[settings.efinance.sync_now]]” and find the row again.
Press “[[settings.deactivate]]” in that row. Then press “[[settings.efinance.sync_now]]”.
exp: Step 2: “[[settings.saved]]”.
Step 3: “[[settings.efinance.result.changed|added=0|updated=1|deactivated=0|reactivated=0]]”. The name is as you wrote it down.
Step 4: “[[settings.efinance.result.changed|added=0|updated=0|deactivated=0|reactivated=1]]”. The row is “[[settings.active]]” again.
The audit log has an “[[audit.event.list_changed]]” row for each hand change and for each sync that changed something.

efin_unknown_cc.title: Step 2 on a test cost centre: eFinance does not know it, so “Yes” needs a comment
efin_unknown_cc.pre: The eFinance link is on. An administrative Nicosia (test) request at step 2, with the cost centre T-1001.
steps: As test.nic.accountant open the request and read the panel “[[card.budget.title]]” on the card.
Answer “[[card.position_available]]” and “[[card.funds_available]]” with “[[answer.yes]]”, leave the comment empty and press “[[card.send]]”.
Write a comment and press “[[card.send]]”.
Read the accountant's answer under “[[page.checks]]”.
exp: Step 1: the panel shows “[[card.budget.scope|code=T-1001|year=(year)]]” and a yellow warning: “[[card.budget.warning.unknown_cost_centre|code=T-1001]] [[card.budget.warning.comment]]”. It lists no budget lines.
Step 2: the card is not sent. Under the comment it says “[[error.comment_required]]” (if the browser check does not run, the page says “[[error.budget_comment_required]]”).
Step 3: “[[done.check]]” and the request moves to step 3.
Step 4: under “[[card.budget.title]]” the answer shows “[[card.budget.stored.unknown_cost_centre|code=T-1001]]”, with the comment.
This holds for every request on a test cost centre. While the link is on, a “[[answer.yes]]” at step 2 or step 4 of the other cases needs a comment too.

efin_setup.title: Prepare a Directorate of eFinance for the budget cases
efin_setup.pre: Ask the project owner which Directorate of eFinance to use (for example HQ). Its roles must have no holder: check the panel “[[settings.roles.empty_title]]”. Never replace a real holder. Use test accounts only.
steps: As the administrator open “[[settings.roles]]” and the group of that Directorate. Add test.nic.requester under “[[role.requester]]” with “[[settings.add]]”.

Choose test.nic.accountant as holder of “[[role.dir_accountant]]”, test.nic.hr of “[[role.dir_hr_officer]]” and test.nic.exec of “[[role.dir_exec]]” (and test.nic.sci of “[[role.sci_director]]” if the row exists). Press “[[settings.save]]” on each row.
As test.nic.requester press “[[list.new]]”, choose that Directorate and open the lists “[[field.facility]]” and “[[field.cost_centre]]”.
Submit two administrative requests on one of its cost centres (position “Secretary (test)”, reason “[[reason.new_need]]”). Write down the numbers and the cost centre.
exp: Steps 1 and 2: “[[settings.saved]]” each time. The roles leave the panel “[[settings.roles.empty_title]]”.
Step 3: the requester can now choose between two Directorates. The cost-centre list holds that Directorate's cost centres with eFinance's codes, and the search box narrows it.
Step 4: the numbers carry the code of that Directorate, for example EHIRE-HQ-SEC-20261126-01. Both requests wait on test.nic.accountant.
Keep these roles for the budget cases that follow. The case “Step 4: the line from step 2, the commitment article and the comment” tells you when to remove them.

efin_card_lines.title: The budget panel at step 2: salary lines, loaded or not, and no amounts
efin_card_lines.pre: The eFinance link is on. The first request of the case “Prepare a Directorate of eFinance for the budget cases”, at step 2.
steps: Open the request and find the panel “[[card.budget.title]]” on the card.
Read the lines above the table.
Read the table and its last row.
Look over the whole page for amounts of money.
exp: The panel has the title “[[card.budget.title]]” and, next to it, “[[card.budget.as_of|date=(date and time)]]”.
Step 2: “[[card.budget.scope|code=(code)|year=(year)]]”, then the notes “[[card.budget.note.level|code=(code)]]” and “[[card.budget.note.no_spending]]”.

Step 3: under “[[card.budget.pick_step2]]” the table has the columns “[[card.budget.line]]” and “[[card.budget.col.state|year=(year)]]”. It lists salary lines only (codes 2102 to 2499), each with its description and either “[[card.budget.state.loaded]]” or “[[card.budget.state.missing]]”. The last row, “[[card.budget.none]]”, is chosen.
Step 4: no amount shows anywhere: no budget, spending, commitments or balance.
When this was written eFinance had no budget loaded, so expect “[[card.budget.state.missing]]” on every line.

efin_no_budget_comment.title: No budget loaded: “Yes” at step 2 needs a comment
efin_no_budget_comment.pre: The same request as in the case above, still at step 2. No salary line of the Directorate has a budget loaded.
steps: Read the yellow warning at the foot of the panel.
Answer both questions with “[[answer.yes]]”, leave “[[card.budget.none]]” chosen and the comment empty, and press “[[card.send]]”.
Write a comment and press “[[card.send]]”.
Read the accountant's answer under “[[page.checks]]”.
exp: Step 1: “[[card.budget.warning.no_budget|year=(year)]] [[card.budget.warning.comment]]”.

Step 2: the card is not sent. Under the comment it says “[[error.comment_required]]” (if the browser check does not run, the page says “[[error.budget_comment_required]]”). The request does not change.
Step 3: “[[done.check]]”. The warning never blocks: a person decides, and the comment records why.

Step 4: under “[[card.budget.title]]” the answer shows “[[card.budget.no_line]]”, “[[card.budget.stored.loaded_count|year=(year)|loaded=0|total=(lines)]]”, the warning “[[card.budget.stored.no_budget|year=(year)]]” and “[[card.budget.scope_entity|code=(code)|entity=(Directorate code)|year=(year)]]”. No amount.
The requester sees none of this, only “[[tracker.state.done]]” for the step.

efin_pick_line.title: Picking a budget line is optional
efin_pick_line.pre: The second request of the case “Prepare a Directorate of eFinance for the budget cases”, at step 2. In the case above the answer was sent with “[[card.budget.none]]”.
steps: Open the request. In the panel “[[card.budget.title]]” press the row of the first budget line.
Answer both questions with “[[answer.yes]]”, write a comment and press “[[card.send]]”.
Read the accountant's answer under “[[page.checks]]”.
exp: Step 1: the row is marked as chosen. A click anywhere on the row picks it.
Step 2: “[[done.check]]”. The answer is accepted with a line, as it was accepted without one in the case above. The card never asks for a line.
Step 3: the answer shows “[[card.budget.line]]:” with the code and description of the line, and “[[card.budget.state.missing]]” (or “[[card.budget.state.loaded]]” if eFinance has a budget for it).

efin_budget_loaded.title: A budget is loaded: no warning, and the warning for a line without one
efin_budget_loaded.pre: Only when eFinance has a budget loaded for at least one salary line of the Directorate, and not for all of them (ask the project owner). Otherwise write “Not run” with that reason. A new request of that Directorate at step 2 (submit one as test.nic.requester, as in the setup case).
steps: Open the card and read the table of the panel “[[card.budget.title]]”.
Press the row of a line marked “[[card.budget.state.missing]]”.
Press the row of a line marked “[[card.budget.state.loaded]]”.
Answer both questions with “[[answer.yes]]”, leave the comment empty and press “[[card.send]]”.
exp: Step 1: at least one line shows “[[card.budget.state.loaded]]”. With “[[card.budget.none]]” chosen there is no warning.
Step 2: a warning appears at once: “[[card.budget.warning.line_no_budget|year=(year)]] [[card.budget.warning.comment]]”.
Step 3: the warning disappears.
Step 4: “[[done.check]]” without a comment. Under “[[page.checks]]” the answer shows “[[card.budget.state.loaded]]” and “[[card.budget.stored.no_warning]]”. Still no amount.

efin_step4.title: Step 4: the line from step 2, the commitment article and the comment
efin_step4.pre: The request of the case “Picking a budget line is optional”, taken through step 3: test.nic.hr answers “[[documentation.complete]]” and test.nic.exec presses “[[action.approve]]”.
steps: As test.central.finmgmt open the request and read the panel “[[card.budget.title]]”.
Press the row of another budget line and look at the field “[[card.commitment_article]]”.
Answer “[[card.credit]]” with “[[answer.yes]]”, leave the comment empty and press “[[card.send]]”.
Write a comment and press “[[card.send]]”.

When the budget cases are done: as test.nic.requester withdraw the test requests of that Directorate. Then, as the administrator, open “[[settings.roles]]”, set its holders back to “[[settings.none]]” and remove test.nic.requester from its requesters.
exp: Step 1: the same salary lines, under “[[card.budget.pick_step4]]”. The line picked at step 2 is already chosen.
Step 2: the code of the line you pressed fills “[[card.commitment_article]]”.
Step 3: the card is not sent and asks for a comment, as at step 2 (the server's own message is “[[error.budget_comment_required]]”).
Step 4: “[[done.check]]”. Under “[[page.checks]]” the answer shows the commitment article and, under “[[card.budget.title]]”, the line and the warning. No amount.
Step 5: “[[settings.saved]]” each time, with no line about tasks left with nobody. The Directorate is back in the panel “[[settings.roles.empty_title]]”.

efin_unavailable.title: eFinance cannot answer: the card says so and works as before
efin_unavailable.pre: Needs a server administrator, who makes eFinance unreachable for eHire for a few minutes (for example a wrong port in EHIRE_EFINANCE_URL in /etc/ehire/ehire.env and a restart of ehire) and then sets it back. eFinance's own service is never stopped. An administrative Nicosia (test) request at step 2.
steps: The server administrator makes eFinance unreachable for eHire.
As test.nic.accountant open the request and read the card.
Answer both questions with “[[answer.yes]]”, leave the comment empty and press “[[card.send]]”.
As test.demo.admin open “[[settings.list.cost_centre]]” and press “[[settings.efinance.sync_now]]”.
The server administrator sets the address back and restarts ehire. Open the card of another request at step 2.
exp: Step 2: in place of the panel one grey line: “[[card.budget.unavailable]]”.
Step 3: “[[done.check]]” without a comment. With no answer from eFinance there is no warning. The stored answer has no eFinance lines.
Step 4: a red message, “[[settings.efinance.result.failed|reason=…]]”. The cost centres stay as they were.
Step 5: the panel “[[card.budget.title]]” is back.

import_position_code.title: Excel import: the position code column
import_position_code.pre: Excel or LibreOffice on your computer. The position “Secretary (test)” has the code SEC; put it back at the end.
steps: Open “[[import.menu]]”, press “[[import.template.download]]” and open the sheet positions.
In the row of “Secretary (test)” type TOOLONG1 in the column code. Save the file and upload it with “[[import.upload.submit]]”.
Change the cell to ts1, save and upload again.
Press “[[import.confirm]]”. Open “[[settings.list.position]]”.
Set the code back to SEC there.
exp: Step 2: “[[import.errors.title]]”. The table names the sheet positions, the row number, the column code and the message “[[import.err.position_code]]”.
Step 3: the summary “[[import.preview.title]]” shows one row under “[[import.preview.update]]” for positions and nothing else to change.
Step 4: “[[import.done|add=0|update=1]]”. The positions list shows the code in capitals, TS1.
A blank cell in the column keeps the stored code.

import_cc_directorate.title: Excel import: a cost centre with its Directorate
import_cc_directorate.pre: Excel or LibreOffice on your computer.
steps: Download the template. On the sheet cost_centres add one row: code T-3301, a Greek name ending “(δοκιμή)”, an English name ending “(test)”, directorate_code T-XXX, active yes. Save and upload the file.
Change directorate_code to T-LIM, save and upload again. Press “[[import.confirm]]”.
Open “[[settings.list.cost_centre]]” and filter by Limassol – Paphos (test).
As test.lim.requester open “[[list.new]]” and the cost-centre list. Do the same as test.nic.requester.
exp: Step 1: “[[import.errors.title]]”. The table names the sheet cost_centres, the row, the column directorate_code and the message “[[import.err.unknown_directorate|code=T-XXX]]”. Nothing is imported.
Step 2: the summary shows one new row, then “[[import.done|add=1|update=0]]”.
Step 3: T-3301 is in the list of that Directorate.
Step 4: Limassol – Paphos offers T-3301. Nicosia does not.

import_roles_move.title: Excel import: a new holder in the file gets the waiting task
import_roles_move.pre: One Larnaca – Famagusta request waiting at step 2 on test.lar.accountant (submit one as test.lar.sci). Excel or LibreOffice on your computer.
steps: Download the template and open the sheet role_holders. In the row dir_accountant, T-LAR, change username to test.lar.deputy and empty substitute_username. Save the file.
Upload it and read the summary. Press “[[import.confirm]]”.
Open the request as test.lar.deputy. As the administrator read “[[settings.roles]]” and the audit log.
Put the row back in the file (test.lar.accountant, test.lar.deputy) and import it again.
exp: Step 2: one row under “[[import.preview.update]]” for role_holders, then “[[import.done|add=0|update=1]]”.

Step 3: test.lar.deputy has the card and an email labelled “[[mail.status.action]]”. The roles page shows the new holder. The audit log has “[[audit.event.role_changed]]” and “[[audit.event.task_redirected]]”. The import page itself shows no line about moved tasks.
Step 4: the roles are as before. The task stays with test.lar.deputy, who is the substitute again.
